# How much of what you earn should you set aside for tax?

> Free India freelancer tax calculator: enter receipts and expenses to see new-regime income tax with the 87A rebate and cess, compare section 44ADA presumptive taxation, get the advance tax schedule and how much of every invoice to set aside. Runs in your browser; nothing is uploaded.

Free and open source (MIT). Results are estimates from the numbers typed in, not legal, tax, financial or professional advice.
